services.title: Inference Services
services.createDescription: Deploys a LeaderWorkerSet workload and a ClusterIP Service in the current cluster that serve an OpenAI-compatible API.
services.emptyHint: Create a service to deploy a registered model in this cluster.
services.noModels: No models registered. Add one in the model registry first.
services.nodeHint: Optional. Node-local models must run on a node that has the model directory.
services.extraArgsHint: Appended to the runtime start command, separated by spaces.

modeHints.single: Each replica is one pod running the whole model.
modeHints.multi: Each replica is a group of pods on several nodes that run one model together.
modeHints.pd: Separate prefill and decode pods behind a router.

services.routerImageHint: Leave empty to use the service image, so the router matches the engine version it routes to. The image must include sglang_router.
services.routerReplicasHint: Replicas prefer different nodes, so the router keeps serving when one node fails.

routerPolicyHints.default: Leaves --policy unset, so the router uses its default, cache_aware.
routerPolicyHints.cache_aware: Sends requests that share a prompt prefix to the server that has it cached, and balances load when servers become uneven.
routerPolicyHints.power_of_two: Picks the less loaded of two random servers.

services.roleImageHint: Leave empty to use the service image.
services.roleImagesDiffer: Prefill and decode run different images. KV transfer needs the same engine version on both sides.
services.routerCacheWarning: Router replicas do not share their cache trees, so cache hits drop with more than one replica.
services.transferBackendNeedsRDMA: Mooncake over RDMA needs an RDMA network. Configure one below or choose Mooncake (TCP).
services.roleEnvHint: One KEY=VALUE per line, added after the service environment variables. A variable set here replaces the service variable of the same name.
services.extraArgsHintPD: Appended to both the prefill and decode start commands; each role's own arguments come after them and can override them.

transferBackendHints.mooncake: Transfers the KV cache over RDMA NICs. Configure the RDMA network below.
transferBackendHints.mooncake-tcp: Needs no RDMA and works on any network, but transfers more slowly.
transferBackendHints.nixl: Needs NIXL in the image. UCX picks RDMA or TCP depending on the network.

services.ibDevicesHint: Optional, comma-separated, such as mlx5_0,mlx5_1. Leave empty to detect them.

rdmaModeHints.none: Traffic between nodes and KV transfer go over the pod network.
rdmaModeHints.device-plugin: An RDMA device plugin, such as the NVIDIA Network Operator or SR-IOV, assigns NICs to pods, which get the IPC_LOCK capability.
rdmaModeHints.host: Pods run privileged in the node network and use the node's RDMA NICs directly. The namespace must allow privileged pods, and a port on a node can be used by only one pod, so each node runs at most one inference pod.

services.rdmaNetworksHint: Use the resource name your device plugin serves. Networks are optional and go into the pod's k8s.v1.cni.cncf.io/networks annotation; setups with dedicated NICs such as SR-IOV need them.
services.envHint: One KEY=VALUE per line, added to every inference container, such as NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX or NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME.
services.scaleDescription: Set the number of replicas. Each replica needs its own GPUs.
services.scaleDescriptionPD: Set the prefill, decode and router replicas.
services.publishHint: Publish this service so callers can reach its model through the gateway with an API key.
services.gatewayRequired: The gateway is not installed in this cluster. Install it on the Gateway page before publishing.
services.unpublishDescription: Callers will no longer reach this model through the gateway. The service itself keeps running.

messages.deleteNote: The workload, router, Service, and storage credential Secret of this service will be deleted.

services.vgpuUnavailable: Install HAMi and switch nodes to vGPU mode on the GPU Resources page to use vGPUs.
services.vgpuMemoryHint: Leave empty to take the whole memory of a GPU. A percentage is of the memory of the GPU assigned.
services.vgpuCoresHint: Leave empty for no core limit.

models.title: Model Registry
models.description: Register offline models stored on node disks or in object storage.
models.nameHint: Also used as the served model name. Letters, digits, dots, underscores, and hyphens.
models.localPathHint: Absolute directory of the model on the node.
models.s3PathHint: Key prefix of the model inside the bucket.
models.storageRequired: Object storage is not configured. Services cannot be created for object storage models until it is.

storage.title: Object Storage
storage.description: One S3-compatible store for the whole platform, used to download models to nodes.
storage.secretKeyKeep: Leave blank to keep the current key
storage.downloaderImageHint: Init container image that runs aws s3 sync.

messages.deleteNote: Existing services keep running, but new services for object storage models cannot be created.

gpus.title: GPU Resources
gpus.emptyHint: No GPU nodes in this cluster. Once the GPU Operator is installed, nodes with NVIDIA GPUs appear here.
gpus.countHint: Whole-GPU nodes count physical GPUs; vGPU nodes count the vGPUs HAMi splits their GPUs into.
gpus.switchDescription: Switch node {{node}} to {{mode}} mode. Stop the pods using GPUs on it first; its device plugin takes a moment to report the GPUs again.

gpuComponents.chartHint: The chart is read from the local chart directory. Offline clusters also need the images below; the cluster pulls them from <registry>/<image>:<tag> using its image registry setting.
gpuComponents.chartMissing: Not in the local chart directory

gpuOperator.title: GPU Operator
gpuOperator.description: The GPU Operator installs the driver, container toolkit, GPU Feature Discovery and DCGM monitoring on every GPU node, and serves the GPUs of nodes in whole-GPU mode.
gpuOperator.driverPreinstalled: The NVIDIA driver is preinstalled on the nodes
gpuOperator.driverHint: Unchecked, the driver container installs the driver; its image tag gets the node OS appended, such as -ubuntu22.04. Check it when the driver container does not support the node OS and install the driver on the nodes yourself.

messages.uninstallNote: Uninstall HAMi and delete the inference services in this cluster first.

hami.title: HAMi
hami.description: HAMi serves the nodes switched to vGPU mode, sharing each GPU by memory and cores among inference services.

messages.uninstallNote: Switch the nodes in vGPU mode back to whole-GPU mode first.

lws.title: LeaderWorkerSet
lws.description: Inference services run on LeaderWorkerSet (LWS). Install it into this cluster before creating services.
lws.chartHint: The chart is read from the local chart directory. Offline clusters also need the image below; the cluster pulls it from <registry>/<image>:<tag> using its image registry setting.
lws.chartMissing: Not in the local chart directory
lws.crdPresent: This cluster already has the LeaderWorkerSet resource definitions, but not a release installed by this platform. If LWS runs here by other means, there is nothing to install.

messages.uninstallNote: Delete every inference service in this cluster first.

gateway.title: Gateway
gateway.description: Install Higress into this cluster as the single entry point for published inference services. It routes each request by the model name in its body and checks the caller's API key. It is exposed through a NodePort.
gateway.nodeHostHint: Enter an IP address or host name of a node in this cluster. Callers reach the gateway at http://<node address>:<NodePort>.
gateway.hubHint: Higress images and plugins are pulled from this registry. Leave blank for the default (Hangzhou). Official mirrors: higress-registry.ap-southeast-7.cr.aliyuncs.com (Southeast Asia) and higress-registry.us-west-1.cr.aliyuncs.com (North America). For an offline registry, mirror the images and plugins listed below under the same paths.
gateway.chartsHint: The chart is read from the local chart directory. Offline clusters also need the images and plugins below; the cluster pulls them from its image registry setting.
gateway.chartMissing: Not in the local chart directory
gateway.addressHint: Published inference services are served at this address. Requests need a caller API key.
gateway.syncHint: Re-applies all callers and published models to the gateway. Use it when a change reported a sync failure.
gateway.upgradeHint: Rate limits, quotas and usage statistics need components this gateway was installed without. Upgrade the gateway in place to turn them on.

messages.uninstallNote: Unpublish every inference service in this cluster first. Callers are kept, but every caller's remaining quota is lost.

usage.title: Usage examples
usage.description: Replace <API_KEY> with a caller key and <MODEL> with the model name of a published service.

callers.title: Callers
callers.description: Each caller has its own API key and a list of models it may access.
callers.empty: No callers. Published models reject every request until a caller is allowed to access them.
callers.notInstalledHint: The gateway is not installed. Callers are saved and take effect once it is installed.
callers.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. Cannot be changed later.
callers.modelsHint: A caller without any model is rejected for every request.
callers.resetKeyDescription: A new key is generated and the current key stops working immediately.
callers.newKeyDescription: Use it as Authorization: Bearer <key>. You can view it again from the callers table.
callers.tokensPerMinuteHint: The most tokens this caller may use per minute across all models. Leave blank or enter 0 for no limit.
callers.limitsUnavailableHint: Rate limits and quotas take effect only after the gateway is installed and upgraded. Install or upgrade it first.
callers.quotaLimitedHint: Requests are rejected once the quota is used up. It never resets on its own; set or add to it from the callers table.
callers.quotaUnknown: The remaining quota could not be read.

usage.title: Usage
usage.trendHint: Input and output tokens per {{minutes}} min
usage.trendHintSeconds: Input and output tokens per {{seconds}} s
usage.empty: No usage in this time range
